description.value: Once per short or long rest, as an action, you overload a target ship's systems, forcing a saving throw against your Disruption save DC. On a failure, until the start of its next turn the target's speed is halved, its turning speed is doubled, it takes a −2 penalty to Armor Class and Dexterity saving throws, it cannot take reactions, it can take only an action or a bonus action (not both) on its turn, and it can make no more than one attack per turn. It cannot regenerate Shield Points while affected.
